product_metadata.title: Legacy Decor Black Adjustable Swivel Counter Height Bar Stools 24" - 29" H, Set of 2
features: Seat dimensions: 16 inches wide x 16 inches deep
Black finish, microfiber seat cushion-beige color. Assembly required
description: These metal bar stools fit into almost any dining, bar, game room or kitchen decor. These stools have a 360-degree swivel design seat and come with extension rods to increase seat from 24 inches to 29 inches. The set includes 2 barstools in a black finish with half circle designs on the back rest. Some assembly required.
